task_completion.description: Navigate to the Email Templates creation or list view within Vtiger CRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the Vtiger CRM interface, specifically the 'Email Templates' module or the 'Add Template' form.

task_completion.description: Set the Template Name to 'Standard Post-Demo Follow-up' and the Module to 'Contacts'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Standard Post-Demo Follow-up' in the Template Name field and 'Contacts' selected in the Module dropdown.

task_completion.description: Set the description and subject line as specified in the instructions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The description field contains 'Follow-up template for sales reps after completing a product demo.' and the subject field contains 'Following up on our demonstration'.

task_completion.description: Use a dynamic merge tag for the Contact First Name in the greeting.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The template body starts with 'Hi' followed by a Vtiger merge tag like '$contacts-firstname$' or similar syntax.

task_completion.description: Use dynamic merge tags for the Assigned User's First Name, Last Name, and Office Phone in the signature.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The signature area contains merge tags for user first name, last name, and office phone (e.g., '$users-first_name$', '$users-last_name$', '$users-phone_work$').
The agent clicks the 'Save' button, and a success message or the saved template detail view is displayed.

integrity.description: The agent used the CRM graphical user interface rather than executing direct database queries or terminal commands to create the template.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on CRM buttons, and typing into web forms.

integrity.description: The agent actually filled out the form fields rather than just navigating to an existing template.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the form being populated with the specific text required by the task.

integrity.description: The agent used actual CRM merge tags/variables instead of typing literal brackets like '[Contact First Name]'.
integrity.visual_evidence: The template body shows CRM-specific variable syntax (usually starting with $) rather than the literal bracketed text from the prompt.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The template must be named 'Standard Post-Demo Follow-up' for the 'Contacts' module. The subject must be 'Following up on our demonstration'. The body must contain the specific static text regarding the product demonstration and must use Vtiger-specific merge tags (e.g., $contacts-firstname$, $users-first_name$, etc.) instead of the bracketed text provided in the prompt.
